description: Extension `VoiceWakeOverlayController` providing session management and UI interaction methods for voice wake overlay in a macOS application.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Initializes and starts a new voice wake overlay session, configuring model states and logging the event.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns the current session's token, source, text, and visibility status.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the overlay with partial transcription, resetting relevant model states.

methods.name: presentFinal
methods.description: Finalizes and presents the overlay with final transcript, auto-sending if specified.

methods.name: userBeganEditing
methods.description: Marks the beginning of editing mode, canceling auto-send tasks.

methods.name: cancelEditingAndDismiss
methods.description: Cancels editing and dismisses the overlay UI.

methods.name: updateText
methods.description: Updates the overlay with new text content.

methods.name: beginSendUI
methods.description: Displays sending UI state and optionally plays a chime, auto-dismisses after delay.

methods.name: requestSend
methods.description: Requests immediate sending of the active session's data.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the overlay, optionally animating its disappearance and notifying relevant components.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the level (e.g., voice activity level) indicator if conditions are met.

methods.name: evaluateToken
methods.description: Static method to verify if a token matches the active session token.

methods.name: scheduleAutoSend
methods.description: Schedules automatic sending of the session after a delay.

methods.name: makeAttributed
methods.description: Creates an attributed string from plain text with default styling.
